English: Ministry of Health urges residents to complete their vaccination before Friday.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inawaomba wakazi kukamilisha chanjo yao kabla ya Ijumaa.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe gia Oboremi na Oborema nigo korigiriria abanto barengete abanto gochia gochia ase ekaunti ya ekaonti ya ebirengererio bia abana babo ase omotienyi 5.

English: IEBC reminds voters to verify their registration details via SMS before the deadline.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawakumbusha wapiga kura kuthibitisha maelezo yao ya usajili kupitia SMS kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho.
Ekegusii: IEBC egokora abamenyi ba aaria ekaunti ya ekaonti ya ekeyia ya ao aao goetera chinchera chikura.

English: Farmers are advised to collect subsidised fertiliser at the nearest depot this week.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kukusanya mbolea za ziada kwenye ghala la karibu zaidi wiki hii.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria abaremi baborigwe aaria ekaonti ya ekaunti ya ebirio ao ekeyia amoyo a ekao ekaonsi ekaomwaka ekaone ekaenerete ekaonchoka ekaao ase omotienyi 6.

English: Schools reopen on Monday; parents should ensure all fees are cleared early.
Kiswahili: Shule hufungua tena Jumatatu; wazazi wanapaswa kuhakikisha kwamba ada zote zinasafishwa mapema.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekorigereria abana bare gochia ase abana baria bare gose obokoreri bwa abana babo ao aaria ekaonti yao.

English: Avoid unnecessary travel to flood-affected areas until further notice.
Kiswahili: Epuka kusafiri bila sababu kwenda maeneo yaliyoathiriwa na mafuriko hadi wakati ujao.
Ekegusii: Ekere okoigora okogesa amache okobwaterana okoboria okorwania okogora okomanya okogenderera okoremereria okosomera okonyora okokomera obokoreri.
